cache_multipliers.honest_part: The template and receipt label them as billing assumptions and require a source field conceptually.
cache_multipliers.defect: The parser only checks that source/cacheRuleSource fields exist; it accepts the unchanged REQUIRED placeholder and computes a receipt anyway. That lets a semantic guess wear a declaration-shaped input without a real source.
cache_multipliers.required_fix: Fail closed when as_of, source, or cacheRuleSource remains a placeholder/unstated value. Keep the illustrative multipliers only as visible template values, never as provider defaults.

prompt_quantity.why: The cheap-model budget is a context-fit question, not a marginal billing question. Cache-created input is also processed input in the request and must count toward the context budget.
prompt_quantity.separation: Keep input/cacheRead/cacheWrite itemized for pricing; use contextInputTokens only for context-window/cheap-model eligibility. Do not use recorded marginal input_tokens as the full prompt size.
prompt_quantity.no_claim: This receipt does not implement the quantity change.
